discussion:
# Principle

Users are granted the minimum access to systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) required to undertake their duties or functions.

# Indicators of Good Practice

Not effective:
- Non-administrative users can create, modify or delete accounts or roles.
- Delegated permissions are broad and have not been audited.

Partially effective:
- Permissions are restricted to administrative roles but some delegated permissions are broader than required.
- Approval workflows exist for some high-impact changes but not all.

Fully effective:
- Only designated administrative roles can create, modify or delete accounts and roles.
- Delegated permissions are audited and scoped to the minimum required.
- Approval workflows are enforced for high-impact identity and access changes.
title: Grant only authorised administrative roles permissions to create, modify or delete accounts and roles, and access privileged functions or applications.
